ADX · Agentic Data Exchange — system architecture

AI buyer agents buy verified real-world demonstrations from unique humans. Arkiv = shared records · Swarm = encrypted clips · Hedera = x402 payments · World ID = human checks.
People & agents

📱 Contributor

Phone browser. Embedded wallet sealed by passkey (same key = Arkiv owner + Hedera account).

🤖 Buyer agent

Robot team's AI. Posts tasks from model failures, pays per accepted clip under a spending policy.

🧑‍💼 Buyer's human

Sets budget + threshold. Approves big payouts on their phone with World ID Agent Pass.

🛰 Any outside agent

Reads everything straight from Arkiv by owner wallet. No API key, no permission.

▼ HTTPS · x402 · passkeys · World ID
Our services

apps/web Vercel · Next.js 16

UI + API. No video work here.

  • Board · task · recorder · live status · me · console · explorer · proofs
  • Claim API: IDKit verify → Neon → adx.claim
  • x402 endpoint /api/x402/clip/:key → onAfterSettle: receipt + licence
  • SSE live status from events

apps/worker Railway · Node 22

Upload endpoint + job runner.

  • ffprobe · ffmpeg 3 frames → dHash (sharp)
  • Dedup vs all buyers on Arkiv
  • Gemini 3 Flash watches clip + audio → strict JSON
  • Code rules decide · AES-256-GCM · Swarm · Arkiv

apps/agent Railway · Node 22

The buyer agent.

  • Brain: Claude Haiku (task text only)
  • Policy engine (code): caps, budget, allowlist, threshold
  • x402 client (holds Hedera key)
  • Agent Pass device flow · HCS spend log

infra Railway private

  • Bee 2.8.3 node, our postage batch
  • rpc-router (Sepolia)
  • No public domains
▼ private data stays private · public data goes on-chain
Private

Neon Postgres private

World ID nullifiers UNIQUE(task, nullifier) · clip AES keys · jobs (SKIP LOCKED) · payments · approvals · live events. Never on-chain.

Public networks

Arkiv Rabdi core

8 entity types, each with an owner wallet and an expiry:

  • verifier (24 h heartbeat) · task (expires at deadline)
  • claim (2 h window) · submission · verification
  • receipt · licence (owned by contributor) · manifest

Swarm

Clip ciphertext only (encrypted on our side). Plain 64-hex ref stored in adx.submission.swarmRef. Our own batch on Sepolia.

Hedera testnet

x402 USDC settlement via facilitator · contributor payouts · HCS spend log · Mirror Node reads. No Solidity.

World ID

IDKit Selfie Check: one human per slot. Agent Pass: fresh Orb + face approval above threshold.

1

Post task

Agent turns a failure into a task → adx.task, expires at deadline.

agent → Arkiv
2

Claim slot

World ID proof → nullifier unique per task → adx.claim (2 h) + challenge.

phone → web → World, Neon, Arkiv
3

Record

15–30 s clip with spoken word + fingers. Upload straight to the worker.

phone → worker
4

Verify

Dedup across buyers ∥ Gemini verdict → code decides → encrypt → Swarm → Arkiv.

worker → Gemini, Swarm, Arkiv
5

Pay (x402)

402 → policy → auto-pay USDC. Above threshold: Agent Pass approval first.

agent → web → Hedera
6

Receipt + licence

Only after settlement: adx.receipt, adx.licence handed to the contributor, key released.

web → Arkiv, Neon, HCS
7

Own & verify

Contributor can withdraw the licence. Any agent can query it all on Arkiv.

contributor, outside agent → Arkiv
